_notes: Weapon inventory for all characters. Static fields: name, element, scaling, effects. Mutable fields: level, power, obtained. Flags (omit if false): obtained, future, rejected. Equipped weapon is in data/characters.json weapon_equipped field.

Maelle.name: Lithum

effects.description: In Virtuose Stance, hitting a Marked enemy doesn't remove Mark.
Switch to Virtuose Stance on Counterattack.
Gain Shell when switching out of Virtuose Stance.

Maelle.notes: Endgame weapon from The Reacher. Nearly doubled in power from level 32 to 33. Respec required from Medalum (Defence+Agility) to Lithum (Luck+Agility).

Shell on leaving Virtuose.

Maelle.notes: Same scaling as Medalum/Lithum — no respec needed. More defensive/supportive than Lithum.

Verso.name: Chevalam

effects.description: Start battle at Rank S, but can't be healed or gain Shields.
20% increased damage for each consecutive no-damage turn, stacks up to 5×.
Apply Rush on Rank S.

Verso.notes: Cheater extra turn counts as no-damage turn and stacks the Level 10 bonus. Confident and Confident Fighter are the recommended Lumina pairing — cannot be healed downside fully priced in by Chevalam.

Verso.name: Corpeso

effects.description: Base Attack applies 2 Burn per Rank.
+1 AP on Rank Up.
Burn damage +50% per Rank up to 300% at S.

Verso.notes: Burn-stacking build. Synergises with Maelle's Burning Canvas.

Verso.name: Contorso

effects.description: Switch to Rank S on Break. Base Attack can Break.
100% Crit at Rank S.
Lightning strike on Crits.

Verso.notes: S-tier Act 3 weapon. Deferred — same rank-loss-on-hit vulnerability as Chevalam, no forgiveness.

Verso.name: Gaulteram

effects.description: Lose only 1 Perfection on hit instead of full rank demotion.

Verso.notes: Act 2 weapon. Forgiveness mechanic critical while parry skills developing. Replaced by Chevalam. Kept for Renoir self-nerf strategy.

Verso.name: Glaceso

effects.description: +1 Perfection on Critical hit.
Self-Heal by 2% Health on dealing a Critical hit.
Counterattack is always a Critical hit.

Verso.notes: Requires respec (Defence+Luck vs Agility+Luck). No forgiveness mechanic. Costs 2 Recoats net.

Verso.name: Simoso

effects.description: An ethereal Sword deals Light damage on any damage dealt with Skills.
20% chance to apply Burn on dealing Light damage.
Can't die if at least Rank A.

Verso.notes: From Simon (Renoir's Drafts). S-tier post-game weapon.

Verso.name: Dreameso
Verso.notes: Rank gain on Counterattack. Deferred until parry/counterattack rate improves.

effects.description: +1 to all Perfection gain but can't reach Rank S.
Base Attack gives 4 Perfection.
20% increased Light damage with Skills.

Verso.notes: Can't reach Rank S. Required for End Bringer stunlock build (Plan F). Purchased from merchant in Renoir's Drafts area. Scaling becomes Vitality A, Agility S at L33.

Sciel.name: Litheson
